notes: 2 section headers — too few for a contents list.
533 words with no section headers at all — the biggest single improvement available here.

decisions.label: Turn the headings into section headers
decisions.why: 2 headings are plain text where every other page uses a section header, so the page reads as one continuous wall instead of parts.

decisions.label: Tag a document link with the format it opens
decisions.why: 163 links on this page open a file — 159 PDF, 3 Word, 1 Video — and say nothing about it, while others in the same list carry a tag because their author typed one. The format is read from the file name, so the list stops being half-labelled. No link text changes.

decisions.label: Put the buttons on the house style
decisions.why: 1 button uses a Bootstrap variant rather than btn-info, so the same kind of action is drawn three different ways across the site. Only the class changes.

decisions.label: Use this paragraph as the page description
decisions.why: It is the page’s own opening paragraph, moved into the banner rather than rewritten.
